author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted — Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.)

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

#ChillingTalesForDarkNights #HorrorArt #HorrorIllustration #ArtistsWanted #PaidArtOpportunities

author: Eden Garden Jewelry
title: We need an illustrator for original characters
content:
We need an illustrator. We can’t tell you why. Not yet

You’re the one if:

 you design original characters, from first sketch to final art

 you can do turnarounds, expression sheets and pose variations

 anatomy is your strength

 fantasy, flora, fauna and hybrid creatures feel like home

 you draw bodies and skin tones of every kind

 your work is hand-made, digital or traditional

 you’re free in October 2026

It’s a bonus if you animate, tell stories in panels, or love Art Nouveau and folklore.

Paid commission. Your style. Your name on every post. NDA until launch.

To apply, email smm@edengardenjewelry.com or DM with your portfolio, 3 characters you love, and the creature you’ve always wanted to draw

author: Macztuh Rockstaa
title: HIRING: 2D DIGITAL ILLUSTRATOR / STORYBOOK ARTIST
content:
HIRING: 2D DIGITAL ILLUSTRATOR / STORYBOOK ARTIST
We’re a startup character brand looking for a talented digital illustrator to bring our original characters and stories to life!

We’re looking for artists who can create beautiful fantasy storybook illustrations with expressive characters, detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, and a magical, cinematic feel, similar to the attached reference.

The illustrations will be used for Instagram and Facebook storytelling posts, where viewers swipe through a series of images to follow a short story.

What we’re looking for:

* Strong 2D digital illustration skills.

* Experience with fantasy environments and expressive characters.

* Ability to maintain consistent character designs across different scenes.

* Strong visual storytelling and composition.

* Good communication and reliability.

IMPORTANT - NO AI ARTWORK

For transparency, the attached reference was AI-generated solely to visualize our concept and desired artistic direction.

We do not want AI-generated or AI-enhanced artwork. All commissioned illustrations must be created by the artist using their own artistic skills.

Budget & Long-Term Opportunity

We’re a startup working with a modest budget, so we’ll be choosing an artist whose quality, style, and rates best fit what we can currently afford.

We respect artists’ time and craftsmanship, and our goal is to build a lasting working relationship with someone who can grow alongside our company.

Interested? Please message me with:

1. Your portfolio or previous artwork.

2. Your rates per illustration and for a complete set of 6 illustrations.

3. Your estimated turnaround time.

4. The software you use.

Thanks so much

author: Thisis Digs
title: Illustrator (Full-Time, Remote)
content:
**Illustrator (Full-Time, Remote)**

We're looking for a talented Illustrator to produce original artwork to brief, ranging from marketing and social content to character design and editorial or children's book illustration. You'll be a dedicated, full-time member of the team. You'll work independently, take direction well, and deliver polished, production-ready files on schedule.

**What you'll be doing**
* Producing original illustrations to a creative brief, in the style and format required
* Handling a steady, ongoing pipeline of projects across multiple briefs at once
* Delivering print- and digital-ready files: layered source files (AI/PSD) plus flattened exports, correct colour mode and resolution
* Incorporating revision rounds based on feedback, professionally and without excessive back-and-forth
* Managing your own timeline against agreed deadlines and flagging early if something's at risk
* Communicating clearly and proactively via WhatsApp and email, with regular overlap for briefing calls

**Required skills & experience**
* Portfolio in PDF format (required for application)
* Proficiency in at least one professional tool: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Procreate, Figma, or Clip Studio Paint
* Solid design fundamentals: composition, colour theory, perspective and proportion
* Able to prepare production-ready files (RGB/CMYK, resolution, layered and flattened formats)
* At least 1 year of paid illustration experience, freelance or in-house
* Proven ability to work from a brief and take direction without ego
* A clean, reliable deadline track record
* Own licensed software and equipment
* Clear written English for async coordination
* Available for full-time hours (40 hrs/week) with consistent overlap with UK working hours

**Desirable**
* A specialty in children's/editorial illustration, character/concept art, or marketing and social content
* Comfortable with regular live video calls

**Engagement tiers (full-time, 40 hrs/week)**
* Junior (up to ~2 years' experience): GBP 600/month
* Senior (3+ years, stronger portfolio depth): GBP 900/month

**How to apply**

Send portfolio and resume to daniel@shorelink.io
